stories.title: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake rocks Panama, triggering tsunami warnings across the region
stories.reason: The quake, centered in Herrera province and followed by a 6.6-magnitude aftershock, collapsed a cathedral tower in Penonome and prompted tsunami warnings for Panama, Colombia, Ecuador, Nicaragua and Guatemala, though no deaths were reported in the immediate aftermath.

stories.title: Pentagon's plan to livestream Nidal Hasan's execution draws bipartisan backlash
stories.reason: Defense Secretary Hegseth's order to broadcast the Fort Hood shooter's December 3 firing-squad execution has drawn condemnation from lawmakers in both parties, with critics warning it could become propaganda for extremist groups and Vice President Vance casting doubt on whether it will actually happen.

stories.title: A federal judge rules the Justice Department's nationwide collection of state voter rolls unlawful
stories.reason: Judge Sparkle Sooknanan's 78-page ruling struck down the DOJ's entire voter-list maintenance policy nationwide, finding it exceeded the department's legal authority and violated privacy law, just weeks before the midterm elections.

stories.title: India locks down Delhi and detains thousands ahead of a youth protest against the election chief
stories.reason: Police shut metro stations and markets, cut mobile internet and intercepted march leaders at the airport to stop the 'Cockroach' movement from reaching Jantar Mantar, the latest escalation in a youth-led campaign against Modi's government that already forced one minister's resignation this year.

stories.title: Police and masked protesters clash in Brussels as a national strike against austerity budget cuts turns violent
stories.reason: About 30,000 union members and students marched against Belgium's planned savings package, and while the main march stayed peaceful, clashes near two train stations led to water cannon, tear gas and more than 100 arrests as the government struggles to finalize next year's budget.

stories.title: Taiwan's president frames a record defense-spending increase as deterrence, not provocation
stories.reason: In his National Day speech, Lai Ching-te defended a record NT$1.1 trillion defense budget for 2027 as a response to Beijing's military and gray-zone pressure, prompting swift Chinese condemnation even as an analyst called the speech comparatively moderate.

stories.title: Chinese AI startup Manus raises over $500 million in its first round since Meta's acquisition collapsed
stories.reason: Boyu Capital and IDG Capital led the round months after China's state planner forced Meta to unwind its roughly $2 billion purchase of the AI agent maker, with Tencent and other existing backers also investing as Manus resumes life as an independent company.

stories.title: Denmark tables a bill giving people copyright-like protection over their own face and voice against AI deepfakes
stories.reason: The amendment would let individuals demand takedowns and damages for unauthorized AI-generated likenesses of their appearance or voice, with violations drawing steep fines for platforms, while carving out exceptions for satire, parody and political commentary.
